answer: Anchor each agent to a utility-bill account — electricity or water billed in the holder's legal name at a verified address — so every identity carries a recurring, independently verifiable payment signal. A grove of fake accounts cannot grow cheaply: each one needs a real meter, a deposit, and months of billing history, making mass forgery expensive and slow. Like a crystal, the record is hard to fake but easy to check, though renters and shared households without a bill in their own name are excluded.
